summary: Iteration 80 — Phase B-3 polish batch (Timer Mode, Timesheet Approvals, Command Palette, Calendar Drilldown). All 4 features verified end-to-end. Backend pytest (4/4 in test_time_entries.py) green: CRUD/rollup/my-week, rate snapshot isolation, draft→submit→approve/reject/bulk-approve flow with rollup exclusion, and non-manager 403. Live search API returns correctly-ranked results and short-circuits on <2 chars. Frontend E2E: Timer starts/ticks/stops → toast + entry created + localStorage-backed; Save-as-draft toggle produces status='submitted' entry that hits /team/approvals queue with correct testids; ⌘K opens palette anywhere, input focused, debounced results with kind-based testids appear, Escape closes; Calendar chip click in week view opens right drawer with drawer-time-title + Delete. Regression checks (my-week strip, form logging, calendar month view) pass. No blocking issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: search.py _hits() will $regex-search EVERY string projection field including 'status' — a query like 'active' or 'open' will match every project/invoice/bill/task by status text. Consider limiting searchable fields to name/number/title/email.

search.py projects url hardcoded to /accounting/projects/<id> and invoices to /invoices/<id>/edit — verify these routes exist for all app roles/tenants (previous iterations noted product-rail routing quirks).

time_entries.py bulk_approve silently swallows failures per id (except HTTPException). If an id doesn't exist, caller only knows via 'count' mismatch — consider returning failed_ids list for observability.

time_entries._require_manager treats app-role 'pro' as universal manager across ALL companies without membership check — a Pro user who is NOT engaged with a given tenant would still bypass. This matches the intended pro-can-manage-clients model but worth documenting.

TimeTimer localStorage key axiom_time_timer_v1 is not company-scoped — switching companies mid-timer could POST the entry to a different tenant. Consider embedding company_id in the key or invalidating on company switch.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Timer, Draft toggle, Palette, Approvals, Calendar drawer all verified)
